[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 10:03  
[USER] User is interested in exercises to strengthen and improve mobility in the eye muscles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended exercises for eye muscle strength and mobility include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Eye tracking exercises: Move the eyes slowly in various directions, following an object or your finger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Focus shifting exercises: Focus on a near object, then shift your focus to a distant object.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Eye rotations: Rotate your eyes in circles, both clockwise and counterclockwise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Near-far focusing: Hold a small object close to your eyes, then move it further away while maintaining focus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Zig-zagging: Follow a zigzagging pattern with your eyes, either vertically or diagonally.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Figure eight: Trace a figure eight pattern with your eyes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Palming: Close your eyes and gently press your palms over your eyes, relaxing and visualizing a dark space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to consult with a qualified optometrist or ophthalmologist before starting any eye exercises to ensure safety and appropriateness.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Warned to stop immediately and consult with an optometrist or ophthalmologist if experiencing any vision changes or discomfort.
